customManagers.description: The buildkitd pull-through registry mirror the spawner pulls at runtime, pinned by version and digest as an environment default rather than an image key, so no built-in manager sees it
The OCI registry the Incus end-to-end lab pushes its images to, pinned by version and digest in lab.sh as a shell constant rather than an image key, so no built-in manager sees it

packageRules.description: Dockerfile images (FROM, COPY --from and the # syntax= frontend) are pinned by digest, image:tag@sha256:…: a tag can be rebuilt under the same name, a digest cannot. Renovate keeps each digest current and opens a pin update for any such reference added without one. Scoped to the dockerfile manager so Compose images are not re-pinned.
GitHub Actions: keep SHA-digest pins current (grouped, short stabilization) so the supply-chain pins don't silently age

GitHub-hosted runner labels (runs-on, depType github-runner): a new OS release waits for approval on the dependency dashboard and is never proposed inside the github actions group, which would hold every action pin behind it. A label moves by a reviewed change made by hand, one group of jobs at a time

better-auth and its WebAuthn/passkey packages move in lockstep: they share one group, and the generic minimumReleaseAge is waived so a security or compatibility bump is not held back out of step with the others
Disable AI SDK packages (manual upgrades only)

CodeMirror and Lezer move together: @tale/ui's code editor and Milkdown share one copy of each, and two copies of @codemirror/state or @codemirror/view break the editor (packages/ui/src/components/forms/code-editor/deps.test.ts)
